notes.title: 🚧 DEV diary #2 🚧
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We’re working on the monster’s long, grasping arms.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674744/80ed61cdda6e260da46d9f2a4c37876ddc8efa38.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]They can emerge from different points - sometimes moving quietly, sometimes striking aggressively. The monster may even try to open doors from inside the store.[/p][p]Players can reinforce doors with planks and chains, but the arms are strong enough to tear through planks and pull off chains.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674744/69785a4f58a99ddff134e0cd766dcfa3cd7e599c.gif"][/img][/p][p]See you on the shift, clerks![/p]

notes.title: 🚧 DEV diary #1 🚧
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We're starting to share more of HELLMART's development.
[/p][p]Expect behind-the-scenes looks, work-in-progress features, and all the weird stuff that goes into building a horror supermarket.[/p][p][/p][p]First up: [b]the day/night cycle.[/b][/p][p]Here’s how it’s looking right now 👇[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674744/a232bdfd3004a994ec56c2b7e8deca91819befeb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Day: odd customers wander in… eerie, but manageable.[/p][p]Evening: lock up and watch the cams - tension building. [/p][p]Night: full horror mode. Don’t open the doors.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We're also working on the monster - trying to make it as creepy and lifelike as possible.[/p][p]Soon, we'll do a separate post about its features and some cool details.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s an early look at the eye animation — it’s still a work in progress… for now, the eyes are just trying to find their way 👀🌀[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674744/e3949ac64017450c952a6e4de169e8fce786ed0f.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Ever felt like something wasn’t quite right in a store? Share your story (we might even add it in the game)![/p][p]❓And what parts of the development process are you most curious about?[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to HELLMART
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Appreciation and eternal store credit to all brave souls who entered the sliding doors of [b]HELLMART[/b].
We stock shelves, scan items, and try not to die.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Announcement Trailer on IGN:[/b][/p][previewyoutube="Jquaclu6G3g;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][p]Stick around — our [b]first playtest[/b] is close, and we’ll need people brave enough to clock in.[/p][p]Stay tuned. Keep the doors locked. And never, ever step outside.

Best,[/p][p]Gaze in Games team[/p]
